description.value: Dumpling Drop has been operating in Victoria's historic Chinatown since 2018, serving deep-fried dumplings with housemade chili oil alongside rotating sides like cucumber salad and mango sticky rice. Founded by Tarn and Toom, the restaurant uses traditional methods with a modern twist and offers dine-in, takeout, and frozen dumplings available at the counter or through Vancouver Island grocery wholesalers. It is a compact, focused spot well-suited to a quick hot meal or stocking up frozen dumplings for the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone, address, email, website). Menu pages confirm takeout and vegan/GF options explicitly; the FAQ page states dumplings are not gluten-free but confirms gluten-free sides exist and a vegan dumpling is on the menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address field omits the unit designator and city ('556 Pandora Avenue, V8W 1N7'); website shows '556a Pandora Avenue, Victoria, BC, V8W 1N7' — unit 'A' is present as a separate OSM tag (addr:unit=A) so the data is consistent but the formatted address field is incomplete in OSM.
No bike parking information found on website or in OSM tags; this is a required WWC criterion that cannot be confirmed without a site visit or staff contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established dine-in and takeout restaurant in Victoria's Chinatown with confirmed active operations; a practical and appealing food stop for touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering available for events with at least 2 weeks notice; frozen wholesale available for Vancouver Island retailers. Nut cross-contamination cannot be guaranteed per FAQ.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a 'Vegan' dumpling and a 'Vegan Weekly Rotating Special'. FAQ confirms gluten-free sides (rice & chili oil, cucumber salad, yuzu Brussels sprouts), though dumplings themselves are explicitly stated as not gluten-free
